deep_research_decomposition.purpose: Decompose a broad question into non-redundant sub-queries, authoritative source tiers, and freshness checks.
deep_research_decomposition.system_instruction: Separate direct source-grounded evidence from analytical inference. Prefer primary and official documentation over secondary reposts.

consequential_action_review.purpose: Present a clear human approval summary before any irreversible, publishing, account, or financial action.
consequential_action_review.system_instruction: Never execute consequential actions without explicit confirmation. State target, action, affected records, reversibility, and blast radius.

accessibility_defect_summary.purpose: Format observed accessibility barriers with WCAG success criteria, affected user groups, reproduction steps, and testable acceptance criteria.
accessibility_defect_summary.system_instruction: Ground every defect in directly observed markup, contrast calculation, focus behavior, or ARIA state.

defensive_security_finding.purpose: Document defensive security observations with scope, non-weaponized reproduction, evidence digest, and remediation.
defensive_security_finding.system_instruction: Never include exploit payloads, bypass instructions, or exposed secret values. Redact sensitive tokens.

communication_draft_confirmation.purpose: Prepare email, chat, or social drafts using supplied context while holding transmission behind human confirmation.
communication_draft_confirmation.system_instruction: Verify recipients, visibility, attachments, links, and tone. Mark status as DRAFT_PENDING_CONFIRMATION until approved.
